newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: BellSouth, Keycorp set up wireless EFTPOS in NZ.
newsitem.headline: BellSouth, Keycorp set up wireless EFTPOS in NZ.

text.p: BellSouth said on Thursday it had signed an agreement with Keycorp (NZ) Ltd to develop and market a portable EFTPOS system to run on BellSouth's GSM digital network.
The service, currently being trialled, is expected to be underway by the end of the year.
Currently there are 29,000 EPTPOS terminals in New Zealand conducting 23 million transaction per month.
BellSouth said the new service would be aimed at mobile businesses such as taxis, couriers and tradespeople. It estimates there are 39,000 potential customers.
BellSouth has not decided on price per transaction but it would be slightly higher than landline connections to reflect the convenience of having mobility.
BellSouth said the service is ideal for a digital network which is more reliable than an analogue system.
